name: ZK Eligibility (semi-private guarded transition)
description: A loan fiber whose pending->eligible transition is gated by a SEMI-PRIVATE guard: it verifies a real SP1-Groth16 eligibility proof (groth16_verify) AND binds the proof's committed public values to a pinned public rule (exprHash==logicHash, outputHash==keccak256("true")) parsed with native substr/cat. The borrower proves they qualify without revealing the private data. Pairs with @ottochain/sdk/zk and the chain SemiPrivateGuard.

events.name: prove
events.description: Carry a valid SP1-Groth16 eligibility proof; the guard verifies + binds it

events.name: prove (tampered)
events.description: A flipped-nibble proof; groth16_verify fails so the guard denies the transition

testFlows.name: Eligible — valid proof advances the fiber
testFlows.description: Create the loan fiber, then submit a REAL eligibility proof; the on-chain guard runs groth16_verify + the public-values binding and the fiber transitions pending -> eligible.

testFlows.name: Rejected — a tampered proof is denied, fiber unchanged
testFlows.description: Create the loan fiber, then submit a TAMPERED proof; groth16_verify fails, the guard denies the transition, ML0 records a RejectionReceipt and the fiber stays at pending (sequence number unchanged).
